Aeson: king of Iolcus and father of Jason in Greek myth
Alcestis: princess of Iolcus, wife of Admetus
Anaxibia: queen of Iolcus, wife of Pelias
Astydamia: queen of Iolcus in Greek myth
Cretheus: king of Iolcus, son of Aeolus
Iolaus: Theban hero, nephew and charioteer of Heracles
Pelias: king of Iolcus, uncle of Jason and antagonist of the Argonauts
Philomache: Minyan princess and queen of Iolcus in Greek mythology
